basics.name: Aravind Narayanan
basics.label: Associate Applied Machine Learning Specialist
basics.summary: Applied machine learning specialist at the Vector Institute, working on model evaluation, Responsible AI, multimodal foundation models, and agentic systems.

work.name: Vector Institute
work.summary: Applied research in model evaluation, Responsible AI, multimodal AI, and agentic systems.
highlights: Contribute to HumaniBench, VLDBench, LinguaMark, AgentFinVQA, FairSense-AgentiX, UnBias-Plus, and work on efficient Responsible-AI evaluation and explainability for agentic systems.
Technical Lead for the Interpretability in LLMs and Agents Bootcamp, mentoring about 100 participants across 20 industry teams.
Technical Lead for the Fall MLA Program, providing technical direction and mentorship on applied ML projects.
Research accepted or published at ACM TIST, Information Fusion, JOSS, NeurIPS workshops, ASONAM, and FTC.

work.name: Vector Institute
work.summary: Internship with the AI Engineering team on evaluation frameworks for multimodal large language models.
highlights: Developed evaluation pipelines for vision-language models, fairness, and disinformation detection.
Contributed to HumaniBench and VLDBench during the internship-to-full-time transition.

work.name: Laboratory for Applied Informatics Research
work.summary: Advanced clustering and labeling for the PATTIE database using AI techniques, improving data management and retrieval.
highlights: Worked with Prof. Javed Mostafa on ML-driven news clustering and information retrieval.

work.name: Neural Robotics Lab
work.summary: Monocular depth estimation for human-robot walking environments.
highlights: Achieved 82.6% accuracy in stair height prediction and 81.4% accuracy in depth estimation.
Collected a custom image dataset using Intel RealSense depth cameras.
Presented a poster at the 2024 Toronto Robotics Conference.

work.name: Bernhardt-Walther Lab
work.summary: Developed pyMLV, the Python version of the Mid-level Vision Toolbox, to extract structural properties from images.
highlights: Engineered tools for studying mid-level representations in biological and artificial vision systems.

work.name: Robotics and Manufacturing Automation Laboratory
work.summary: Software for collaborative robots using machine learning and robotics dynamics.
highlights: Designed a manipulator proficient in gesture recognition, obstacle avoidance, and object transfer to humans.

work.name: Center for Computational Social Science, IIIT Hyderabad
work.summary: Computational social science research on social media, elections analysis, and fraud detection.
highlights: Analyzed politicians' social media use and built a BERT-based model for Play Store fraud classification.

education.area: Electrical and Computer Engineering (Data Analytics and Machine Learning)
highlights: Poster at the 2024 Toronto Robotics Conference.

education.institution: International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad
highlights: Dean's and Merit List for five semesters
Teaching Assistant for Processor Architecture, Systems Thinking, Probability, and Statistical Methods in AI
Marketing Head, Entrepreneurship Cell; Robotics Club Head; Photography Club Head
